reasonableness.revised_prompt:
Merge Mansion-class casual merge inventory overview, 2x4 white rounded cards on dark charcoal. Soft-plastic thick props, studio softbox, short contact shadow, shipped-game shelf quality. Exactly one item centered per card. NO face, NO eyes, NO expression, NO text, NO level numbers. NO flock, NO multiple birds in any cell, NO hen house, NO gold armor crown fantasy.

Fresh garden-bird ladder (single bird density, not chicken-flock logic):
L1 closed warm oval egg with fine crack lines.
L2 cracked shell with round yellow fluff mound peeking, almost no wings.
L3 standing yellow downy chick short beak short wing buds, faceless stylized.
L4 juvenile: yellow down mixed with first flight feathers, short tail.
L5 adult songbird-like: honey-apricot full plumage, clear wing layers, small tail fan.
L6 richer adult: thicker feather layers, wing edges opened, larger tail fan — still ONE bird.
L7 crest bird: readable head crest tuft with first red crest accent.
L8 max single ornamental: draped feather mantle layers + taller denser crest, largest silhouette, still ONE bird faceless.

Gentle scale ramp. Fail-at-glance: faces/eyes, 2+ birds, coop, gold plate armor, padded old chicken-flock layout.
